info.title: dotnet-cnb (dotnet cnb) — tooling for Cnblogs.Architecture.
info.description:
dotnet-cnblogs-sa: generates strongly-typed CQRS service agents (IXxxService / XxxService) from a
      Cnblogs.Architecture API project that uses MapQuery / MapCommand.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Bake this base URL into the generated AddXxxService extensions (otherwise each takes a baseUri argument).

options.name: --api-version
options.description:
Emit only endpoints declared for this API version, as one un-suffixed IXxxService per group.
Omitted: every version is emitted; a group spanning several versions is split into
IXxxV1Service / IXxxV2Service / ... per version.
